title: Measure whether capability is improving
summary: Track whether people are working differently and whether it makes a difference, not just whether they attended training.

beginner: Go back to the baseline from your maturity assessment.
Repeat the assessment after a few months.
Ask PMs and partners what has changed.
Share the results with the sponsor.
intermediate: Measure reaction, learning, behaviour and results.
Link changes to business outcomes where you can.
Adjust the programme based on the results.
experienced: Report capability progress to leaders alongside business results.
Compare teams to find what works best.
Use the evidence to argue for continued investment.

canDelegateTo.task: Run the repeat assessment and survey

toolExamples.google-docs: Compare repeat assessment scores with the baseline.
